text:
Ana Gomez: Hey team, quick urgent q — I have a consulate appointment for my visa tomorrow and they asked for proof of health coverage. I don’t have my physical ID card (lost it). Can someone confirm what form of temporary proof you can provide? :pleading_face:
Jamal Patel: Hi Ana — we can send an enrollment verification letter and a digital ID card. Do you need a signed letter or just a PDF export?
Ana Gomez: Ideally signed would be best. The consulate said it must show plan name, policy number, and active dates. Also need it on company/insurer letterhead if possible.
People Ops: Hi Ana — we can do that. We have a template for an Enrollment Verification Letter that includes plan name, member ID, dates, and is on insurer letterhead. We can add a company signature if needed. Would you like us to email it directly to the consulate or to you?
Ana Gomez: Please email me and I’ll print and bring it. Email: ana.gomez@example.com. Member ID is 512-34-987. Coverage start: 2024-07-01. Dependent: Marcos Gomez (son), DOB 2019-03-12 — he’s on my plan.
benefits-bot: Automated: Received request and created ticket BENEFITS-2417. Expected turnaround 1 business day. Link: https://benefits.internal/requests/BENEFITS-2417
Jamal Patel: Thanks for the details. We’ll generate the signed enrollment letter and a PDF of the digital ID card (front/back). We’ll also include a short cover note confirming dependent coverage. Will send to ana.gomez@example.com and cc you, Ana.
Rebecca Lin: FYI consulates sometimes want a letter that explicitly states "medical coverage for travel/visa purposes" and confirms no waiting period for emergency care. If you want we can add that clause to the letter.
Ana Gomez: Yes please add that clause — it would help.
Lisa Chen: I can co-sign on company letterhead. @Jamal do you want me to add my signature or do you prefer HR’s standard signature block?
Jamal Patel: If Lisa can sign, that’s perfect — use the standard HR signature block and include a scanned wet signature.
People Ops: Noted. We’ll prepare: 1) Signed Enrollment Verification Letter (insurer + HR wet signature) 2) Digital ID card PDF 3) Short cover note referencing visa/consulate requirements. ETA: sending within 3 hours.
Ana Gomez: Amazing, thank you so much!! :relieved: Will confirm after I receive it.
Jamal Patel: Sent to ana.gomez@example.com and cc:people-ops@redwood.com — subject: "Enrollment Verification for Visa — Ana Gomez (BENEFITS-2417)". Let us know if consulate requests anything else.
benefits-bot: BENEFITS-2417 status updated: Completed by Jamal Patel at 2024-11-06T09:28:10Z. If you need additional attestation for the consulate, reply in-thread or open a new ticket.
